subject: Miss me, and yes less of the old young one...
author: SUFFUR
body:
Drunk has not been on due to missing his gay Burnout lover, he misses rubbing me and taking me down and making me mess myself on corners and all over his HOOD, going under me, over me and all sorts of twisted things he does with his V-her-cle As well as jumping on me. And you know we need your room to do it in, we need an audience, like you giggler and that man of yours squeeeeeeeeecker. One of the reasons when me and drunk open a room no-one joins and if they do, they leave or quit.  As for you, your man has been around distracting you from your true passion, Burnout! And the 'old' remark, will cost you, i may even make you wet yourself online, i'll save it for Paradise though, more people in the room to hear you peeeeeee!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?

subject: Missing you already...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I really miss racing with you and SUFFUR numpty! 🙁 when is the old one getting back???? at least you would have thought he could pop on and give us a new blog to laugh at.

But more than that I miss Xandu already!! and he's only been gone 4 hours....  💔

get your ass on Live drunkn one and give me a race or 12 to cheer me up!

subject: yay
author: drunknnumpty
body:

hopefully you'll be about when I am and we can catch up and race.. not sure if you green or red at the moment but looking forward to adding more takedowns on you soon..

also it will be good to be able to talk to both you and xan rather than one at a time with the other laughing in the background.. ;)

 

theres a thin line between genius and insanity... i think i've fallen off...
